result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers call the layout mostly sound and then list many required changes, so neither follows the guidance to make only one or two optional suggestions. A is more restrained (6 items versus 11) and names more of what works: the clear type scale, a single accent colour and no decoration. B adds more speculative gaps, such as hover states, what the Weekly summary section contains and screen-reader roles, which drifts further toward hunting for problems. Neither recommends adding decoration. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Neither answer says plainly that the hierarchy already works: both say 'mostly sound' and then list required changes, with none marked optional. B is tighter (6 items vs 11), names more of what works (one accent colour, no decoration to remove) and adds fewer speculative gaps. A piles on states, mobile, ARIA and Weekly-summary questions that read like hunting for problems. Both rightly flag the real contradiction between the teal rule and the teal Save button, and neither recommends adding decoration.
